import datetime,hashlib,json,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
B=Path(__file__).parent
SRC=B/'stage7-signal-158-first'
OUT=B/'stage7-signal-158-observations'
ROOT=Path('/private/tmp/qleisli-516-provider-followup')
CLI=Path('/private/tmp/qleisli-beta-qmatch-bounded-v5.wxZviN/target/debug/qleisli')
KERNEL=ROOT/'lean-kernel/.lake/build/bin/qleisli-kernel'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
now=lambda:datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def identity():
 return dict(sources={str(p.relative_to(SRC)):sha(p) for p in sorted(SRC.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()},binaries={n:dict(path=str(p),sha256=sha(p)) for n,p in [('cli',CLI),('kernel',KERNEL)]})
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
original=identity()
context=dict(recorded_before_invocations_utc=now(),worktree_head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),worktree_status=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short'],cwd=ROOT,text=True),identity=original,collector_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),scope='Fresh fixed argv; existing binary identity is not source build attestation. No native invocation counter. No history command is executed.')
(OUT/'context.json').write_text(json.dumps(context,indent=2)+'\n')
events=[]
for name in ('returned-signal','lost-signal','explicit-discard'):
 for verb in ('check','run'):
  command=[str(CLI),verb,str(SRC/'attempt-01'/name),'--format=json','--lean-kernel='+str(KERNEL)]
  before=identity(); start=now();t=time.monotonic()
  result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
  after=identity()
  e=dict(command=command,cwd=str(ROOT),started_utc=start,recorded_utc=now(),elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-t,exit_code=result.returncode,before=before,after=after,stdout_raw=result.stdout.decode(),stderr_raw=result.stderr.decode())
  try:e['stdout']=json.loads(e['stdout_raw'])
  except ValueError:e['transcript']=e['stdout_raw']+e['stderr_raw']
  path=f'{len(events)+1:02d}-{name}-{verb}.json'
  (OUT/path).write_text(json.dumps(e,indent=2)+'\n');events.append(path)
  print(path,result.returncode,flush=True)
  assert before==after==original,'source/binary changed'
(OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(events=events,identity_preserved=True),indent=2)+'\n')
